WITH orders_in_period AS ( SELECT ORDERT.ORD_CODE, ORDERT.ORD_NAP, ORDERT.ORD_SU, PRODUCT.CORP_CODE FROM ORDERT INNER JOIN PRODUCT ON PRODUCT.PROD_CODE = ORDERT.PROD_CODE INNER JOIN CORP ON CORP.CORP_CODE = PRODUCT.CORP_CODE WHERE ORDERT.ORD_DATE >= #{sdate} AND ORDERT.ORD_DATE < DATEADD(DAY, 1, #{edate}) AND ORDERT.ORD_NAP IS NOT NULL AND ORDERT.ORD_NAP <> '1900-01-01'
AND CORP.CORP_NAME LIKE '%'+#{corp_name}+'%'
), shipped AS ( SELECT ORD_CODE, MAX(OCH_DATE) AS OCH_DATE, SUM(ISNULL(OCH_SU, 0)) AS SHIPPED_SU FROM OCHULGO GROUP BY ORD_CODE ), calc AS ( SELECT o.ORD_CODE, CASE WHEN s.SHIPPED_SU IS NOT NULL AND s.SHIPPED_SU >= o.ORD_SU THEN s.OCH_DATE ELSE NULL END AS COMPLETE_DATE, o.ORD_NAP FROM orders_in_period o LEFT JOIN shipped s ON s.ORD_CODE = o.ORD_CODE ), calc2 AS ( SELECT ORD_CODE, COMPLETE_DATE, CASE WHEN COMPLETE_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN DATEDIFF(HOUR, ORD_NAP, COMPLETE_DATE) ELSE NULL END AS gap_hours, CASE WHEN COMPLETE_DATE IS NULL AND ORD_NAP < GETDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_overdue_incomplete FROM calc ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN COMPLETE_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shipped_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN COMPLETE_DATE IS NULL AND is_overdue_incomplete = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_shipped_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN is_overdue_incomplete = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_unshipped_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN gap_hours > 0 OR is_overdue_incomplete = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN COMPLETE_DATE IS NOT NULL AND gap_hours <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ontime_cnt,
ISNULL(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN gap_hours > 0 OR is_overdue_incomplete = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN COMPLETE_DATE IS NOT NULL OR is_overdue_incomplete = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2), 0) AS late_rate, ISNULL(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN COMPLETE_DATE IS NOT NULL AND gap_hours <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN COMPLETE_DATE IS NOT NULL OR is_overdue_incomplete = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2), 0) AS compliance_rate, ISNULL(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN COMPLETE_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(gap_hours AS FLOAT) END), 2), 0) AS avg_gap_hours, ISNULL(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN gap_hours > 0 THEN CAST(gap_hours AS FLOAT) END), 2), 0) AS avg_late_hours FROM calc2

WITH orders_in_period AS ( SELECT ORDERT.ORD_CODE, ORDERT.ORD_NAP, ORDERT.ORD_SU, PRODUCT.CORP_CODE FROM ORDERT INNER JOIN PRODUCT ON PRODUCT.PROD_CODE = ORDERT.PROD_CODE WHERE ORDERT.ORD_DATE >= #{sdate} AND ORDERT.ORD_DATE < DATEADD(DAY, 1, #{edate}) AND ORDERT.ORD_NAP IS NOT NULL AND ORDERT.ORD_NAP <> '1900-01-01' ), shipped AS ( SELECT ORD_CODE, MAX(OCH_DATE) AS OCH_DATE, SUM(ISNULL(OCH_SU, 0)) AS SHIPPED_SU FROM OCHULGO GROUP BY ORD_CODE ), calc AS ( SELECT o.ORD_CODE, o.CORP_CODE, CASE WHEN s.SHIPPED_SU IS NOT NULL AND s.SHIPPED_SU >= o.ORD_SU THEN s.OCH_DATE ELSE NULL END AS COMPLETE_DATE, o.ORD_NAP FROM orders_in_period o LEFT JOIN shipped s ON s.ORD_CODE = o.ORD_CODE ), calc2 AS ( SELECT ORD_CODE, CORP_CODE, COMPLETE_DATE, CASE WHEN COMPLETE_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN DATEDIFF(HOUR, ORD_NAP, COMPLETE_DATE) ELSE NULL END AS gap_hours, CASE WHEN COMPLETE_DATE IS NULL AND ORD_NAP < GETDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_overdue_incomplete FROM calc ), corp_agg AS ( SELECT CORP.CORP_NAME AS corp_name, COUNT(*) AS total_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN c.COMPLETE_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shipped_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN c.COMPLETE_DATE IS NULL AND c.is_overdue_incomplete = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_shipped_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN c.is_overdue_incomplete = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_unshipped_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN c.gap_hours > 0 OR c.is_overdue_incomplete = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_cnt, ISNULL(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN c.gap_hours > 0 OR c.is_overdue_incomplete = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN c.COMPLETE_DATE IS NOT NULL OR c.is_overdue_incomplete = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2), 0) AS late_rate, ISNULL(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN c.COMPLETE_DATE IS NOT NULL AND c.gap_hours <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN c.COMPLETE_DATE IS NOT NULL OR c.is_overdue_incomplete = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2), 0) AS compliance_rate, ISNULL(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN c.COMPLETE_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(c.gap_hours AS FLOAT) END), 2), 0) AS avg_gap_hours FROM calc2 c INNER JOIN CORP ON CORP.CORP_CODE = c.CORP_CODE
WHERE CORP.CORP_NAME LIKE '%'+#{corp_name}+'%'
GROUP BY CORP.CORP_NAME ) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY late_rate DESC) AS row_num, corp_name, total_cnt, shipped_cnt, not_shipped_cnt, overdue_unshipped_cnt, late_cnt, late_rate, compliance_rate, avg_gap_hours FROM corp_agg ORDER BY late_rate DESC
